I'm tracing where each dot sits relative to the two vertical lines at col4 and col12, drawing horizontal connecting lines to whichever vertical line is nearest, and marking a square at each touch point where lines meet.

Now I'm working through the grid row by row, noting that squares take precedence over line cells when they overlap, and carefully assigning 8s and 2s to each column based on which square or line segment covers that cell.

Continuing the grid: row9 mirrors row7, and for the dot at (14,16) I mark the connecting line and surrounding square cells across rows13-16 accordingly. For the remaining middle rows (4,5,6,10,11,12) I set col4 and col12 both to 8 as vertical line segments.
